groups.operation: Exercise ucl_parser_free on a saved, unattached comment after a parse error.
groups.condition: ucl_parser_add_string parses a line comment followed by an unterminated quoted key.
groups.capability: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput must create the parser with UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS and call ucl_parser_free on the error path.
groups.consequence: The saved-comment cleanup in ucl_parser_free is not exercised.
groups.equivalence_reason: This targets configuration and reachability of the saved-comment cleanup.

groups.operation: Free the parser created by LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput after malformed input.
groups.capability: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput must call ucl_parser_free before returning on the error path.
groups.consequence: The parser and its owned state remain allocated.
groups.equivalence_reason: This targets an existing parser leak on the error path, distinct from exercising saved-comment cleanup.
